title: Pip and the Curly Shell
note: b413 — Learning — Phase 3, r-vowel teams ar, or, ur, 44-sound stage.

pages.brief: Pip the sparrow perched high up on a branch of a big oak tree.
Pip the sparrow looking closely at a small curled object wedged in the branch, clearly not a nut.
Pip the sparrow pecking at the curled object and turning it over with his beak.
Close view of the object, a small pale shell with a tight spiral curl.
Pip the sparrow turning the pale shell one way, then the other, inspecting it from both sides.
Pip the sparrow tilting his head, comparing the curled shell to a small horn-shaped twig beside it.
Pip the sparrow standing beside the pale spiral shell, having worked it out.
Pip the sparrow perched happily on top of the pale shell on the oak branch.
